description: Estimate profit on a Canadian house flip: land transfer tax (with first-time buyer rebate), renovation with contingency, holding costs, realtor commission and closing costs, then the tax bill. Flags the CRA residential property flipping rule (held under 12 months = 100% business income, no capital gains treatment) and the tax saved by waiting past 12 months.

afterRepairValue.description: Expected resale price after renovation (ARV) in CAD

city.description: City name — include 'Toronto' to add the Toronto municipal land transfer tax

closingCostsBuy.description: Purchase legal/inspection costs, excluding land transfer tax

contingencyPct.description: Contingency as a percent of renovationCost

holdingPeriodMonths.description: Months held from purchase to sale — under 12 triggers the CRA flipping rule

isFirstTimeBuyer.description: Eligible for the first-time buyer land transfer tax rebate

marginalTaxRatePct.description: Your combined marginal tax rate as a percent

monthlyHoldingCosts.description: Monthly carrying costs: mortgage interest, property tax, insurance, utilities

province.description: Province; sets the land transfer tax

realtorCommissionPct.description: Realtor commission on the sale as a percent of ARV

renovationCost.description: Budgeted renovation cost in CAD, before contingency

name: house_flipping
title: House Flipping Profit Calculator (Canada)
